class TokenCache:
    def __init__(self, refresh, clock, skew=30):
        self.refresh = refresh
        self.clock = clock
        self.skew = skew
        self.token = None
        self.expires_at = 0

    async def get(self):
        if self.token is None or self.expires_at <= self.clock() + self.skew:
            self.token, self.expires_at = await self.refresh()
        return self.token
